title: Word On The Street: Keep Your Coins, I Want Change
author: Nathaniel St. Clair
content:
[![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_2139-680x510.jpg)](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/13/word-
on-the-street-keep-your-coins-i-want-change/)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_2139-680x510.jpg)

"Who wants all this shit?" Photograph by Nathaniel St. Clair, CounterPunch -
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en)

These are some photographs I have taken of street messages I have come across
while walking or cycling around Portland, OR. Some are political. Some are
jokes. Some are both. Some I agree with. Some I definitely don't. Some I can't
make heads or tails of. But maybe they will resonate with you.

They are free to share and use, as long as you credit:  
'Photograph by Nathaniel St. Clair, CounterPunch - [CC BY
4.0′](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_1157-680x572.jpg)

"Remember to take care of others!"



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_2146-680x510.jpg)

"A budget is a statement of values."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_1787-680x510.jpg)

"No airbags. We die like real men."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_2157-680x510.jpg)

"Developer domination unjust. Overpopulation unwise. Liberal fascism built
upon lies."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_6831-2-680x510.jpg)

"I wanna be higher than the cost of living."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_2158-680x510.jpg)

"White lives matter. Time to take a stand."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_6097-680x506.jpeg)

"Good night, white pride."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_6354-680x510.jpeg)

"Be the light."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/IMG_0556-680x510.jpeg)

"Keep your coins, I want change."
